methods.name: private void pop()
methods.comment:
* Removes a path segment. When this method returns the last segment is always "", which means * the encoded path will have a trailing '/'. * *

Popping "/a/b/c/" yields "/a/b/". In this case the list of path segments goes from * ["a", "b", "c", ""] to ["a", "b", ""]. * *

Popping "/a/b/c" also yields "/a/b/". The list of path segments goes from ["a", "b", "c"] * to ["a", "b", ""].

methods.comment:
* Performs IDN ToASCII encoding and canonicalize the result to lowercase. e.g. This converts
     * {@code ☃.net} to {@code xn--n3h.net}, and {@code WwW.GoOgLe.cOm} to {@code www.google.com}.
     * {@code null} will be returned if the input cannot be ToASCII encoded or if the result
     * contains unsupported ASCII characters.
